patterns: APPSC asks this topic almost entirely as direct single facts: Alluri's tomb (Krishnadevipeta), first PS attacked (Chintapalli), rebellion years (1922-24), Madras Forest Act (1882).
Duggirala angles recur: leader of Chirala-Perala, Ramadandu volunteer corps (distractor Shanti Sena), title Andhra Ratna.
Match-the-following of Andhra leaders -> movement/title/book (Veeraiah Chowdary-Pedanandipadu, Kaleswara Rao-Naa Jeevitha Katha, Tripuraneni-Kavi Raju).
Trap: 'Andhra Shivaji' (Veeraiah Chowdary) vs 'Andhra Ratna' (Duggirala); Hyderabad State Congress 1938.
App MCQs go much deeper (1879-80 Rampa revolt leaders, British officers, Pedanandipadu Congress split) with many 3-4 statement items, while PYQs are one-liners.
